Subject: Pilot evaluation and compliance add-ons: timeline & budget

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Finlay Bank is ready to run a 6-week pilot focusing on customer support summarization and compliance auditing for transcripts. Before we lock dates I need a clear mutual action plan (MAP) tying milestones to commercial terms: pilot acceptance criteria, required ramp commitments for production, and pricing for the compliance/security add-ons (audit logs export, extended retention, premium access controls).

Can you send a one-page MAP and a short pricing attachment that shows:
- pilot vs. production unit pricing
- per-month cost for audit log streaming and 1yr/3yr retention tiers
- any discounts tied to committed monthly tokens or annual commit

We'd like to share this with procurement by Friday (2026-06-04). Also: Finlay will require SOC 2 evidence and an audit logs sample. Who on your side owns that?

Thanks,
Sarah

Subject: Re: Pilot evaluation and compliance add-ons: timeline & budget

Sarah —

Appreciate the clear ask. Attached are two files: Finlay_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones and owners) and Compliance_Addons_PRICING_v2.pdf (line-item pricing for audit logs, retention tiers, and premium controls). High level summary below and proposed schedule.

Summary (pilot -> prod):
- Week 0: Kickoff & environment access (we provide VPC link + onboarding checklist).
- Weeks 1–4: Pilot running - success metric: >=90% pass on QA prompt set and avg generation latency <300ms for configured path.
- Week 5: Pilot review — decision point (go/no-go).
- Weeks 6–10: Ramp to production (if committed) — commit tiers and discounts apply upon signed reserved capacity or annual commit.

Commercial highlights (see attached for full table):
- Pilot pricing: metered hosted API at list rate; pilots under 50k tokens/month qualify for a single 30% evaluation credit applied to first invoice.
- Production commit bands: 0-1M tokens/mo, 1-5M tokens/mo (5% discount), 5M+ (12% discount); annual commit adds incremental 6% rebate at year-end.
- Compliance add-ons: audit log streaming $1,200/mo baseline + $0.05/GB ingested; retention tiers: 1yr (included), 3yr (+$2,000/mo), 5yr (+$4,000/mo); premium access controls (role-based PKI integration) one-time setup $8,000 + $400/mo.
- Discounting: additional rebatable discounts tied to 12-month commit and multi-region (US+EU) replication.

SLA/attestation: Neha will own SOC 2 evidence and can provide the evidence pack and an audit logs redaction sample by EOD Thu (2026-06-03).

Next steps I propose:
1) Quick sync Wed 2026-06-03 16:00 ET to walk the MAP and pricing line items (30 min).
2) You confirm pilot start date (we've got bandwidth for 2026-06-15).
3) Procurement receives the one-page MAP and the pricing PDF (attached).

If that timeline works we'll prepare a lightweight SOW and a DocuSign link to formalize the evaluation commitment and any reserved capacity terms for ramp.

Thanks,

Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Email: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Finlay_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP, owners & milestones); Compliance_Addons_PRICING_v2.pdf (pricing table)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Sarah Olsen <sarah.olsen@finlaybank.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 14:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pilot evaluation and compliance add-ons: timeline & budget

Tessa / Sarah — quick follow on from our side after reviewing the MAP:

- Discount structure: to make ramp commitments simpler for Finlay, propose a staged discount trigger: once Finlay hits 3 consecutive months in the 1-5M band, we auto-upgrade discount from 5% to 8% and apply the annual rebate pro-rata. This helps reduce revenue friction on month 1 of production.
- Audit logs: data egress and retention pricing above assumes logs are delivered to the customer's S3 endpoint. If Finlay prefers Redwood-managed retention we add a compliance handling fee (already in the PDF) and can include encryption-at-rest using customer-managed keys (KMS) for an additional $500/mo.
- SLA: premium latency SLA (p95) can be offered for dedicated pools; requires a reserved capacity commitment (min 2 GPUs equivalent). For procurement redline simplicity we can offer a 30-day termination window for the pilot SOW.

Sarah — can you confirm whether procurement needs a redline-ready contract or if a simple SOW + order form is sufficient to start? If they need contract redlines, we should loop Legal and expect ~3 business days to turn.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

Tessa / Marcus —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the detailed MAP. Procurement reviewed the pricing PDF and the retention options; we are comfortable starting the pilot on 2026-06-15 with the following clarifications before sign:

1) Please provide SOC 2 Type II report and a sampled audit logs export (redacted) by next Tue (2026-06-16).
2) We prefer the logs to be delivered to Finlay-managed S3 (no Redwood-managed retention). Confirm the $0.05/GB ingest rate and the baseline $1,200/mo apply to this mode.
3) For ramp discounts, Finlay requests the staged discount language in writing in the SOW (the 3-month trigger Marcus suggested).

Procurement indicated they can accept a SOW + order form to start the pilot; they do not require legal redlines for the evaluation SOW. After pilot acceptance we'll circle back on reserved capacity for production and finalize the annual commit.

Please send the SOW_Draft.docx and a DocuSign link for the order form when ready. Once we have the SOC2 pack we'll route internally.

Best,
